pipeline.title: ESXI
pipeline.description: VMware/vSphere extraction. Single stage runs the drop rule (drop_message() short-circuits matched messages) AND the two vmware_app extractors. Was previously split into stage 0 + stage 1, but Graylog stages with `match either` and a single rule whose `when` is False (the normal case for non-LLDP traffic) cause the stage to fail to advance, so stage 1 never ran for 99.9% of messages — vmware_app extraction silently dropped.

rules.title: drop esxi snmpd lldp noise
rules.description: ESXi hosts spam ~9K snmpd LLDP_RebuildMIB / LLDP_ProcessSwitch / LLDP_ProcessPort errors per day at level 3. They're documented-harmless artifacts of the VMware snmpd not knowing how to parse the LLDP MIB. Drop at ingest so the ESXi stream isn't 80% noise.
rules.source:
rule "drop esxi snmpd lldp noise"
when
  has_field("message") &&
  contains(to_string($message.message), " snmpd") &&
  contains(to_string($message.message), "LLDP_")
then
  drop_message();
end

rules.title: vmware app from application_name
rules.description: vCenter messages already have application_name extracted by Graylog. Copy to vmware_app for unified dashboard use.
rules.source:
rule "vmware app from application_name"
when
  has_field("application_name")
then
  set_field("vmware_app", to_string($message.application_name));
end

rules.title: vmware app from message
rules.description: ESXi host syslog (Hostd, snmpd, Vpxa, vmkernel, etc) doesn't get application_name parsed because the format is '<host> <app>[pid]?: ...'. Regex out the tag and set vmware_app.
